Hi,

I have some feedback about Recall:

privacyFirst.title: Privacy First
privacyFirst.description: Recall is built with privacy as a core principle. We believe your personal relationships and the information you record about them should remain private and under your control.

localStorage.title: Local-first storage
localStorage.description: Your contact data, notes, facts, and memories are stored locally on your device. They only leave your phone when you use online features such as AI processing, login, or subscriptions.

dataSovereignty.title: Data Sovereignty
dataSovereignty.description: You have complete ownership of your data. Export it anytime in JSON or CSV format. Delete it whenever you want. No contact cloud, no data mining.

aiProcessing.title: AI Processing
aiProcessing.description: Voice transcription (Groq Whisper) and text analysis (Cerebras) are processed through secure APIs only when you record or ask questions. Avatar generation uses OpenAI GPT Image 2. We configure AI providers so your content is not used to train models.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: Questions about your privacy or data? We're here to help.

aiConsent.title: AI Data Processing
aiConsent.subtitle: Recall People uses third-party AI services to transcribe your voice recordings, extract contact information, answer questions, and generate avatars. Here's what you need to know.
aiConsent.voiceData: Voice recordings are sent for speech-to-text transcription
aiConsent.textData: Transcribed text, contact names, notes, and question text are analyzed to extract information, create summaries, suggest questions, and answer you
aiConsent.avatarData: Text descriptions (gender, age, style) are used to generate illustrated avatars
aiConsent.noTraining: Your data is never used to train AI models
aiConsent.noStorage: AI providers process data to return results, not to train models
aiConsent.localFirst: Your app database is stored on your device; AI data is sent only for requested processing
